messages:
jamal: Heads-up — last call before cutoff in 45m. PR #5320 bumps the version for the emb-runtime quick fix and needs a changelog line. I pulled the branch into staging; CI is flaky but the change is tiny (dependency pin). Requesting a late-merge exception.
priya.k: Can you post the exact PR link and a one-liner for changelog? We need the exception form filled: https://go/release-exceptions
jamal: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5320
changelog: "fix: pin emb-runtime to avoid NPE on cold start"
alex_m: CI is currently failing on a flaky test `TestKVCacheEviction` — rerunning. If it passes, +1 from me. :eyes:
release-bot: Release window starts in 30 minutes for v1.14.0. Cutoff = 2473000030. Submit exceptions to /release-exceptions and tag @release-leads.
sylvia: If CI is green and changelog added, I'm ok with exception. Please include rollback guidance in the PR description.
carla: For cherry-pick, use:
```
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b hotfix/emb-pin origin/main
git cherry-pick -x <commit>
git push origin hotfix/emb-pin
``` 
Also add a short rollback snippet in description.
jamal: Thanks — rerun passed :thumbsup: I've updated PR description with rollback steps and changelog line. Filling exception form now.
priya.k: Noted. Once form is in, I'll rubber-stamp and merge after checks.
jamal: Form submitted: https://go/release-exceptions/entries/98765
priya.k: Received. Merging once the release lead gives final nod. @sylvia can you confirm when you're ready?
sylvia: Affirmative. Merge after 1 more green run and I'll stamp.
alex_m: Second green run finished, all good. :tada:
jamal: Merged and cherry-picked to release branch. Thanks everyone — keeping fingers crossed. :rocket:
